people.name: Nebuzaradan
people.line: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.

translations.web: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.
translations.bsb: But Nebuzaradan captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields.
translations.kjv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
